decision: Not adopted: replacing the nap's 'reconcile TOTAL problems: 0' verification step on the grounds that memory_engine.py has no reconcile verb.
reopen_if: reconcile_memory_index.py is removed or renamed, or no longer prints a TOTAL problems line.
why: The premise was wrong: the reconcile the nap means is the reconcile_memory_index.py script with --check, which exists and prints that TOTAL line. It was never a memory_engine.py subcommand.

anchors: Do not strip the frame by hand
decision: The nap names its commands: store_manifest.py backup --scope chain and verify --out <backup dir>, one reconcile_memory_index.py --check call over the whole chain (home skills/meta-self-improve/), session-reviewed --transcript PATH for an owed earlier transcript, and a framed show --body file goes back to --body-file unstripped.

evidence.text: CLI help read for store_manifest backup/verify, reconcile --check, dream_state --transcript; memory_engine._framed_body passes a framed body through and _synced_frame re-syncs description. GREEN opus and haiku wrote the commands; haiku split reconcile per level, closed and re-probed.

reopen_if: store_manifest, reconcile_memory_index or dream_state change these flags or homes, or the engine stops passing a framed body through.
why: Naps lost tool calls to 'verify: the following arguments are required: --out' and a No-such-file on hooks/reconcile_memory_index.py; a bare session-reviewed advanced the live session's watermark by 8.4 MB unread; a nap hand-stripped a frame the engine stores once anyway.

decision: Step 3 finds candidates with dedup_scan.py --scope chain, which reads only the facts the chain's levels point at; exit 1 candidates are read before any fold, and exit 2 puts chain dedup on the deferred list.

evidence.text: RED: two new dedup_scan tests failed (no scope argument); GREEN 162 passed. Real store: --scope chain from the marketplace repo scanned 609 facts in 29 s, control detected. GREEN probes kept --scope chain out of the full-dream control.

reopen_if: The tree-wide scan becomes fast enough for a nap, or the chain scope misses facts the chain owns.
why: The tree-wide dedup_scan ran past 3 minutes in a nap and was stopped, so chain dedup was deferred twice.

anchors: marks nothing when no review came since the last mark
decision: A bare session-reviewed marks the file this session's last session-review showed, up to where that view ended, and marks nothing when no review came since the last mark.

evidence.text: test_dream_state.py pins the same-file, grown-file and second-mark cases; each mutation of those lines was killed.

reopen_if: session-review stops recording what it showed, or the review and mark verbs are merged.
why: Re-resolving the transcript at mark time marked a different file than was read when the owed flag moved or a peer shared the directory.

anchors: in propose mode the nap lists the fact and its cost
decision: A nap follows the dream mode for a move to the tree top (the anchor), which is a misplacement re-home because a nap runs no promotion gate: propose mode lists it in the report with its cost (the bytes it adds to the top block) for the user's approval and does not apply it; auto mode applies it and prints its cost in the report; a manual run under `off` proposes it, as propose mode does. Moves down from the anchor and between other chain levels are applied in every mode.

evidence.text: User decision 2026-11-10: Propose in propose mode, apply in auto. Measured: store backups 2026-11-09, nap intervals added 140 top pointers against 71 removed over 85 intervals.

reopen_if: Pointer placement is generated from topics (phase 2), naps stop running on the anchor's chain, or the top block's growth under auto mode makes the user revisit the choice.
why: The anchor's block loads in every session of the tree, and naps, run many times a day, moved the second most pointers to the top. The user chose to keep auto mode hands-off and make every move to the top carry its cost.
